title: perf: skip charges from before identity was recorded
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Before 2026-05-12 checkout created a throwaway Stripe customer per purchase and wrote the user id only on the Checkout Session, so those charges carry no identity the scan can use. A live scan on 2026-09-16 attributed **0 of the 12,248 charges before May** and 100% from June onward.

- Lower-bounds the charge list at 2026-05-01, keeping an 11-day margin before the deploy that fixed identity.
- Drops ~35% of the charges scanned each hour with no change to the candidate list.
- Disputes and warnings are listed by their own date, so one can reference a charge older than the window. `paymentFor` now retrieves the charge and skips it only when it provably predates the window; an unknown or unreadable date still fails the scan as an incomplete page.
- Test: a recent dispute against a pre-window charge is skipped rather than failing, and the existing incomplete-coverage guard still fires.

gist.headline: The scan knows its seasons
gist.blurb: The fraud scanner now leaves the pre-identity fossil record alone. Fewer Stripe charges to inspect, with the same useful trail of suspicious pollen.
gist.summary: The hourly Stripe fraud scan now starts at 2026-05-01, avoiding pre-May 2026 charges created before checkout records reliably carried user identity while still resolving and safely skipping older charges referenced by recent disputes or warnings.
gist.impact: The scan processes roughly 35% fewer charges per hour without changing its candidate list, while incomplete or unreadable charge data continues to trigger the existing coverage guard.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy archive-garden metaphor for pruning irrelevant historical records: Polli, wearing a tiny archivist visor, tends a calendar-shaped hedge and marks May 2026 as the beginning of a well-labeled charge trail. Older unlabeled paper receipts rest safely in a background compost bin while a friendly CRT monitor robot checks recent dispute notices, representing careful handling of references outside the scan window.
